subject: Medical Necessity Appeal - Claim CLM-2026-005097 (Line 1)
body: Per policy POL-UHC-72148@v1#p1, conservative therapy of at least 6 weeks is required. Clinical note ENC-CLM-2026-005097-CN@v1#p1 documents 6 weeks of completed physical therapy.

grounded_claims.statement: Policy requires at least 6 weeks of conservative therapy.
Patient completed 6 weeks of physical therapy without relief.
